title: black cat girl 🤝 golden retriever boy. don’t miss I & you at the @McC...
transcript: name a better combo than a black cat girl and a golden retriever boy that perfectly describes Caroline and Anthony our two protagonists in I & You a brand new musical premiering at the McCarter Theatre in Princeton New Jersey I was invited to attend the opening night of I & You and it was so special partly because the show has such an incredible creative team behind it and partly because I am completely obsessed with this cast the brilliantly talented Jasmine Forsberg plays Caroline a prickly creative teenage girl who has recently become too sick to attend high school and has basically given up on normal until her classmate Anthony played by the charming and lovable Benji Santiago shows up in her bedroom with an English assignment on Walt Whitman and reminds her how to live again it’s deeply funny and beautiful and will make you feel all of the feelings Jasmine and Benji had incredible chemistry they were magic on stage together their vocals were breathtaking I really love the music and I hope they release a cast album after the show I got to go to a little opening night party and even hear from members of the creative team What a privilege To Shepherd something Entirely new thanks for trusting us all with letting Anthony and Caroline story sing on Benji and Jasmine get to shine and break our hearts make us laugh and sing ari’s incredible work I think that the story is radical because these are two strangers and humans who get to learn and experience and know each other On an atomic level go support a new musical and see I & You McCarter Theater until October 12
